Build and assemble a full boundary logic result in one step

bl_build_result.Rd

Convenience wrapper that combines bl_build_projection(), bl_build_grid(), and bl_assemble() into a single call. Accepts the output of either bl_prepare_data() or bl_filter_outliers() and extracts train_data and var_names automatically.

Usage

bl_build_result(
  bl_data = NULL,
  bl_model = NULL,
  method = "PCA",
  proj_dims = c(1L, 2L),
  standardise = TRUE,
  cva_classes = NULL,
  title = "",
  m = 200L,
  outlie = 1,
  calc_hull = TRUE,
  b_margin = 0.001
)

Arguments

bl_data

A "bl_data" object from bl_prepare_data() or a "bl_filter_result" from bl_filter_outliers(). The function extracts train_data and var_names from whichever is supplied.

bl_model

A "bl_model" object from bl_fit_model() or bl_wrap_model(). When NULL (default), only the projection is built and a bl_projection object is returned.

method

"PCA" or "CVA". Default "PCA".

proj_dims

Integer vector of length 2; eigenvector indices for the biplot plane. Default c(1L, 2L).

standardise

Logical; standardise features before PCA. Ignored for CVA (always FALSE). Default TRUE.

cva_classes

Optional factor of class labels (one per training row) for CVA. When NULL and bl_model is supplied, four-class confusion labels (TP/TN/FP/FN) are used. When NULL and no model is supplied, binary as.factor(train_data$class) is used automatically.

title

Character; biplot title. Default "".

m

Integer; grid resolution (m x m). Default 200L. Ignored when bl_model = NULL.

outlie

Numeric in (0, 1]; convex hull fraction for the prediction grid. Default 1. Ignored when bl_model = NULL.

calc_hull

Logical; trim the prediction surface to the training hull. Visual only — does not affect counterfactual search. Default TRUE. Ignored when bl_model = NULL.

b_margin

Numeric scalar; half-width of the band around cutoff used to extract the decision boundary contour. Default 0.001 (contours at cutoff +/- 0.001). Must satisfy 0 < b_margin < 0.5. Independent of prediction precision: all prediction scores are always floor-rounded to 3 decimal places inside .pred_function() regardless of b_margin. Ignored when bl_model = NULL.

Value

A "bl_result" object (when bl_model is supplied) or a "bl_projection" object (when bl_model = NULL).

Details

When bl_model is NULL the grid and assembly steps are skipped. A bl_projection object is returned instead of a bl_result, and plot() on that object renders the biplot without any prediction surface.

Assumption: the projection matrix V is always built from the train_data slot of the supplied object. Building V from test data or any other source is not supported here — use bl_build_projection() directly if a non-standard data source is needed.

For advanced control over any individual step use bl_build_projection(), bl_build_grid(), and bl_assemble() directly.

Typical usage (with model)

# With outlier filtering:
bl_results <- bl_build_result(bl_filt, bl_mod, method = "CVA")

# Without filtering:
bl_results <- bl_build_result(bl_dat, bl_mod, method = "PCA")

Exploratory biplot (no model yet)

bl_proj <- bl_build_result(bl_filt, method = "PCA")
plot(bl_proj)   # renders biplot coloured by true class (red/blue)
